CustomField.formula: IF( ISPICKVAL( Quote_Type__c , "Recontract"), IF( ISPICKVAL( Payment_Type__c , "Due Payment"), (Gross_Total1__c + Amount__c + (Gross_Total1__c + Amount__c) * Tax__c ), (Gross_Total1__c - Amount__c + (Gross_Total1__c - Amount__c) * Tax__c)), (Gross_Total1__c + (Gross_Total1__c * Tax__c)) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This formula calculates the adjusted gross total by incorporating an additional amount and tax amount based on the type of quote and payment type.
CustomField.label: Net Total
